art.title: POV: your first udon shop in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (chef + customers freeze staring at the ladle in the udon pot, steam and noren keep moving)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (chef, male voice: こっちで注文だよ！ / Order over here!)
the wait (chef cooks the udon, customers eat, steam drifts)
punchline: self-service, just not THAT self-service.
pdca.hook: You serve yourself straight from the kitchen. The whole shop freezes.
